text:
maria: FYI I opened a docs PR for the private VPC installer — hit an edge case we didn't document around DNS egress on NAT instances vs NAT Gateways in AWS. The install flow can fail DNS resolution for cluster nodes if the NAT instance blocks TCP/UDP 53 to the VPC resolver. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567

jamie-docs: can you paste the minimal troubleshooting steps/snippet here? i can fold into the guide and add a note in the installer checklist. :eyes:

maria: yep. minimal checklist I added: 1) confirm your NAT (instance or appliance) allows outbound UDP+TCP on port 53 to the VPC resolver (VPC+2 address, e.g. 10.0.0.2). 2) on NAT instances with iptables, add an allow rule for DNS forwarding. snippet I put in the PR:```sh# on NAT instance (iptables-nft) - allow forwarding to VPC resolveriptables -I FORWARD -p udp --dport 53 -d 10.0.0.2 -j ACCEPTiptables -I FORWARD -p tcp --dport 53 -d 10.0.0.2 -j ACCEPT# persistent example (netfilter-persistent or equivalent)```

alex-eng: good catch. security note: prefer limiting the rule to the cluster subnet IP range instead of open forwarding. eg add `-s 10.0.64.0/20 -d 10.0.0.2` so only node CIDRs can query the resolver. also mention that if using a NAT gateway this is usually already allowed.

sam-sre: can we add a minimal systemd-resolved workaround for nodes that use the stub resolver? some distros have `127.0.0.53` stub and won't forward to the right resolver through the NAT. i suggested a short snippet to set /etc/systemd/resolved.conf per-node:```ini[Resolve]DNS=10.0.0.2Domains=~internal.company.localFallbackDNS=```and then `systemctl restart systemd-resolved`

maria: added both snippets to PR and left an explicit "if you use NAT instance" callout. also added an airgap note: for sealed/offline installs you must run an internal DNS forwarder (e.g., dnsmasq) on the dmz hop that forwards to your on-prem resolver — otherwise name resolution for image registries and KMS endpoints will fail.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint + linkcheck running on PR #4567 — will post results.

tony-cs: customer reported this yesterday (blocked by their corporate NAT appliance). thanks for documenting — can we surface this in the quickstart troubleshooting matrix too? saved hours for them.

jamie-docs: yes i'll add an entry to the troubleshooting matrix and a cross-link to the installer note. maria can you add one short sentence about "how to identify this" — suggest `dig @10.0.0.2 example.com` from a node and `tcpdump -i eth0 port 53` on the NAT to confirm drops.

maria: added that command and a short tcpdump example to the PR. updated PR description with screenshots from our repro.

sam-sre: will run the smoke-runner against the PR tomorrow to make sure nothing else regresses.

alex-eng: lgtm from infra side after tests. pls squash commits and mark ready for review.

maria: thanks all. tagging @jamie-docs to merge once CI passes and smoke tests are green. :shipit:
